OUSD contracts them under a Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School master contract for Special Education; Devereux Ackerman Academy is a nonpublic therapeutic school serving K-12 students in a residential treatment setting
Devereux Georgia is a center of Devereux Advanced Behavioral Health, a nonprofit registered as Devereux Foundation (ProPublica, EIN 23-1390618)
research.notes: Profile describes the Devereux Georgia / Ackerman Academy site; legal name and EIN are those of the parent nonprofit Devereux Foundation (Villanova, PA). Email is the school's general inbox. No CA entity number or UEI checked.

profile.summary: Devereux Advanced Behavioral Health is a national nonprofit that provides behavioral health, special education and related services to children and adults. Its Georgia center in Kennesaw offers residential treatment, specialty foster care and a fully accredited K-12 school, Devereux Ackerman Academy.

review.notes: Devereux Ackerman Academy at 1291 Stanley Road, Kennesaw GA is a nonpublic K-12 special education school, matching the agenda's name, location and Special Education purchase; the Devereux Foundation (EIN 23-1390618, Villanova PA) is its parent nonprofit. Headquarters 'Kennesaw, GA' is the site location, not the organization's headquarters (ProPublica shows Villanova, PA), so it is unsupported.
